Professional fashion photograph, full body shot, vertical portrait-orientation. TWO women placed side by side.

#1: a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo auburn hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school blazer set, a cropped sleeveless blazer-style top of ultra-thin matte navy scuba crepe with gold-trimmed lapels, a small gold crest patch on the left of her chest and a slim navy-and-gold striped tie at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the scuba crepe fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte light-grey scuba crepe with a thin navy stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin scuba crepe molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the gold-trimmed lapels, the small gold crest and the striped tie crisp against the navy, the fine pleats of the grey skirt, a smooth pebbled crepe texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: sitting on the ground behind the landmark with her legs stretched out to one side and crossed at the ankles, one hand resting on top of the landmark, the other hand planted on the ground, chest lifted, chin raised, positioned on the left side of the landmark, standing slightly behind it, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

#1: Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.

#2: a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, wolf cut ash brown hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of three stacked horizontal turquoise neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, with one turquoise neon tube loop rising from the center of the bandeau up around her neck as a halter, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of hot-pink neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: standing behind the landmark with one forearm resting on top of it, weight on one leg, the other hand on her hip, chin lifted, looking at the camera, positioned on the right side of the landmark, standing slightly behind it, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy pure white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in pure white lacquer with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
#2: Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Environment: a real famous tourist site photographed at true scale, Rome with the Colosseum, the Roman Forum ruins and terracotta rooftops placed in the foreground at the centre of the frame, rising only to the height of the women's waists and thighs, tourists and tour buses and cars around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; both women are colossal giants standing one on each side of the landmark, slightly behind it, so that the landmark overlaps only their inner legs and clearly shows how much taller than it they are, their towering heels planted on the ancient paved streets, a clear blue sky with soft clouds behind them, the landmark and both women fully in focus, lit by bright natural daylight with soft shadows.
All: Extreme macro detail on the outfits, the skin and the shadows. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a medium distance with the camera at knee height, the famous landmark large in the foreground at the centre of the frame with one woman standing on each side of it slightly behind it, the whole figure of both women from their feet to the top of their heads completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating their shoes from the ground with the real buildings, cars and trees around their ankles shown at their true size so their colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
